judgments.reason: The DANDI 000055 record, "AJILE12: Long-term naturalistic human intracranial neural recordings and pose", is the original release of this exact data. It has the same authors and 12 participants, 55 days of recordings, and wrist-movement events.
judgments.paper_title: AJILE12: Long-term naturalistic human intracranial neural recordings and pose

judgments.reason: The Scientific Data AJILE12 descriptor has the same authors and describes the same 12-participant, 55-day ECoG and pose dataset that this BIDS record converts from DANDI 000055.
judgments.paper_title: AJILE12: Long-term naturalistic human intracranial neural recordings and pose

judgments.reason: The eNeuro 2021 paper analyzes the same 12-subject naturalistic ECoG data, but it is an analysis study. The data descriptor is Peterson et al. 2022 (AJILE12), so this paper is not the data paper.
judgments.paper_title: Behavioral and Neural Variability of Naturalistic Arm Movements

judgments.reason: Singh et al. 2021 (J Neurosci Methods) is a precursor method paper on mining behaviors from long-term video and neural recordings; the AJILE12 data paper is Peterson et al. 2022.
judgments.paper_title: Mining naturalistic human behaviors in long-term video and neural recordings
